scientific_integrity: Explicit Gaussian conditioning and rational polynomial certificates support the claimed threshold; numerical quadrature is supplementary. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to one noisy scalar observation of either displacement or its derivative from the once-integrated standard Brownian bridge on a unit interval.
The measurement-noise variances are assumed equal after calibration of different physical output units; results are not invariant under arbitrary relative scaling.
Published priority is qualified by an inaccessible related dissertation full text and the possibility of equivalent unindexed work.
title: A sharp displacement-to-velocity sensing switch for integrated Brownian-bridge recovery
